summary: Owen Merriman's local copy of a sample-intake training deck (9 June 2022), reworded for Vellacombe's sample desk. It walks through receipt, logging and storage of incoming samples, with handover annotations and a contact box that still needs updating.

slides.title: Sample intake: training for new starters
slides.subtitle: Vellacombe Discovery Ltd, a Tarnovell company | 09 Jun 2022

slides.title: Why intake matters
bullets: Every sample we receive is logged before anyone weighs it
A sample without a LIMS accession cannot be tracked into a delivery lot
Most intake queries come from samples that arrived with incomplete paperwork

slides.title: Receiving a delivery
bullets: Check the courier note against the sample manifest before signing
Note any broken or leaking containers on the receipt sheet, with a photo

bullets.text: Cold-chain items go straight to the controlled storage room

bullets: Ring the partner's contact if the manifest and the containers disagree

slides.title: Logging in
bullets: Accession number issued on receipt, not before
Client reference copied exactly as written on the manifest
Container type and fill volume recorded in mg or mL
bullets_right: Storage location entered in LIMS before the sample leaves the desk
Handwritten masses are transcribed twice and initialled
Anything unclear goes to Andrew May the same day

slides.title: Chain of custody
bullets: Every move between the bench and storage is recorded in LIMS
The person who moves a sample initials the move
Samples leaving the building go out with a signed transfer note

slides.title: When something goes wrong
bullets: Damaged or unlabelled sample: quarantine it and tell the team lead
Missing sample: search the storage log before raising it
Never relabel a sample from memory

slides.title: Contacts
bullets: Sample desk: Andrew May, Sample Management Coordinator
Analytical release questions: Clara Fenwick
slides.footer: Sample desk contact box - still shows the sender's old phone list. Update before issue.

slides.title: Quick check before you sign
bullets: Manifest matches the courier note
Every container has a label and a client reference
Storage location logged
Samples you could not place are flagged, not stored
slides.notes: Adapted from the Brindlewythe 2021 intake pack. Remove any leftover wording from that pack before this goes to new starters.
